message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to any incoming data throughout the pipeline stages shown.

No detected untrusted source handling: The Wikipedia dump is downloaded via a plain requests.get call with no checksum verification, signature check, or pinned revision; the scrapers likewise perform no integrity or authenticity checks.

No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution comparisons, expected-set validation, or noise-detection tools (e.g., Cleanlab) are applied to the labels produced in labeled_texts, labeled_count_sentences, or labeled_date_sentences.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preparation pipeline (scraping, HTML parsing, text normalization, embedding) performs no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs against poisoned data.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads serialized models and embeddings (e.g., Word2Vec via gensim, KeyedVectors, and pickle files) without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to confirm integrity.

No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance or validates label distribution before training; the pipeline simply loads labels and passes them to classifiers without any distribution checks.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or mechanisms are imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) or stress tests are used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set isolated from training data, signed/hashed evaluation data, or multiple independent metrics to protect against metric manipulation; the evaluation logic visible uses GridSearchCV and learning curves but no explicit isolation or integrity controls.
No detected input sanitization: No input validation, schema checks, or shape/range guards are applied to incoming data before it is passed through the pipeline or to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: There are no checks on model outputs such as probability bounds, NaN guards, or threshold validation anywhere in the visible inference code path.

No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses classical ML models (SVM, Logistic Regression, Naive Bayes, etc.) rather than an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
